pr.title: fix(code): explain worktree collisions instead of leaking git's fatal
pr.body: Navigation, `sync`, and `new --prepend` leaked git's raw `fatal: '' is already used by worktree at ...` followed by `git exited with status 128`. The refusal is correct; what was missing was git-stk saying what to do about it. Now they name the destination and both ways out. Checked *before* the switch rather than after: `status` replays git's captured stderr on failure, so a post-check would have left the raw fatal on screen underneath our message. Detection is structural, never string-matching git's wording, which varies by version and locale. Closes #278 - 🟣 ~~[fix(sync): skip a trunk fetch and a landing checkout another worktree blocks (#295)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/295)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[docs(guide): add a worktrees tour covering the flows and gotchas (#294)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/294)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add new --worktree, with git-stk owning the worktrees it creates (#293)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/293)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(run): run in a scratch worktree by default, with --no-worktree to opt out (#292)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/292)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add --from-path to nav commands so cd can follow a branch (#291)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/291)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(list): show which worktree holds each branch in list and status (#290)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/290)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(code): explain worktree collisions instead of leaking git's fatal (#289)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/289)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[fix(code): keep a worktree-held branch instead of failing cleanup (#288)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/288)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(restack): preflight worktree-held branches and clear stale state (#287)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/287)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(stack): refuse an undo that would rewind branches held by worktrees (#286)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/286)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(code): add git::worktree_branches to detect branches held elsewhere (#285)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/285)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: The worktree-collision message tells users to free a branch with `git worktree remove`, which deletes the other worktree and any work in it, when detaching it is enough.

prior_bot.note: bot reviewed the message only for path quoting
